title: Lemlist Review (2026)
intro: Lemlist is evaluated here as sales intelligence software — Multichannel cold outreach platform (email, LinkedIn, SMS, dialer) with lead database and enrichment credits — Email plan from $55/user/mo (yearly headline), Multichannel from $87/user/mo, Enterprise custom, 14-day free trial. Landscape cold-email/outbound infra for SI pages — not a ranked contact-DB peer. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s sales-intelligence methodology (contact data, prospecting, enrichment, email outreach, CRM sync, usability, reporting, value). It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose lemlist when multichannel cold outreach is the job — treat it as SI landscape cold-email coverage, not a ranked contact-database pick.
verdict: Choose lemlist when multichannel cold outreach is the job — treat it as SI landscape cold-email coverage, not a ranked contact-database pick. Compare Instantly/Smartlead for cold-email infra; Outreach/Salesloft for enterprise SEP; Apollo/Hunter when data+light outreach is primary. Scores reflect first-party documentation — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging on the vendor site before purchase.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Includes a lead database, but lemlist’s center of gravity is multichannel outbound — not a ranked SI contact-DB peer.
Account-based prospecting and lead finder support outbound; weaker than dedicated SI databases.
Pay-per-success enrichment credits help, but depth trails Clay/Clearbit-class enrichment platforms.
Email + multichannel sequences with deliverability hub are a category strength.
Native CRM integrations (HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive) are first-party documented.
Published Email/Multichannel ladder and trial path are approachable for SMB outbound teams.
Campaign reporting supports outbound coaching; not enterprise SI/ABM analytics.
Yearly Email-from-$55 is clear; Multichannel and credits raise TCO — still more transparent than opaque SEP quotes.

faq.question: Is Lemlist a CRM?
faq.answer: No. Lemlist is sales intelligence / prospecting software. Keep a CRM of record (HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, etc.) and use Lemlist for discovery, enrichment, intent, or account prioritization as applicable.

faq.question: How is Lemlist priced?
faq.answer: Email from $55/user/mo (yearly); Multichannel from $87/user/mo (yearly); Enterprise custom. 14-day free trial. Enrichment credits separate. Confirm on lemlist.com/pricing.

faq.question: Did SoftwareGlimpse personally test Lemlist?
faq.answer: No. This review is based on first-party product and pricing research evidence, not hands-on product usage.
